ideas.pitch: A real-time anomaly detection dashboard tracking system-wide API calls and infrastructure metrics to prevent cascading catastrophic failures across microservices.
ideas.title: Multiverse Timeline Integrity Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Avengers/Doomsday hero theme by framing system reliability engineering as saving the multiverse, which will amuse judges.

ideas.pitch: An edge proxy tool that uses lightweight classification models to intercept and reroute corrupted or malicious network payloads before they crash application servers.
ideas.title: Quantum Packet Interceptor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a working live demo with a cinematic theme that fits the Doomsday/Avengers branding of the hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A spatial intelligence platform that ingests live satellite data and crowdsourced reports to optimize emergency relief supply chains during simulated crises.
ideas.title: Doomsday Disaster Resource Allocator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuine geospatial data processing and solves a high-impact real-world challenge, a pattern seen in successful hackathon entries.

ideas.pitch: An explainable graph-based risk intelligence platform for detecting fraudulent transactions and illicit wallet movements across multi-chain networks.
ideas.title: Nexus AML Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the technical complexity and graph intelligence used in previous first-place winning compliance tools.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision platform utilizing MediaPipe to track user reaction times and physical fatigue during high-stress operational tasks.
ideas.title: Heroic Biometric Reflex Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an instantly demonstrable browser-based camera feed that engages judges through interactive live testing.
